No. In OrderLoop, an item that is a gift card can't be refunded. In `backend/app/rules.py:30-31`, an item's `refundable` property is `not (self.final_sale or self.gift_card)`. Gift cards are therefore left out of the refundable total. If an order has only gift cards and final-sale items, it gets the `no_refundable_items` blocker. The feature doc `docs/feature-refund-status.md` says the same: "items that are final sale or gift cards never count."

ANSWER: no
